identity.name: Cielo Rojo Restaurant
identity.notes: The restaurant-controlled homepage, current menu page, and restaurant-linked Toast storefront all identify the same family-owned Cielo Rojo at 7211 Carroll Avenue in Takoma Park. Older third-party and legacy Toast references to 7056 Carroll Avenue were excluded and not merged into the current location scope.

sources.excerpt: The official homepage identifies Cielo Rojo as a family-owned contemporary Mexican restaurant at 7211 Carroll Avenue, Takoma Park, MD 20912, and links the menu and Toast ordering storefront.
The live restaurant menu page exposes July 2026 daily and vegan images and March 2026 brunch, happy-hour, kids, and nonalcoholic/drink images, each labeled with its current service period.
Restaurant-issued DINNER MENU UPDATE JULY 2026 pages 1-2 enumerate the current daily food menu and literal ingredient, contains-nuts, dairy, gluten, peanut, soy, fish, and shellfish statements.
Restaurant-issued BRUNCH MARCH 2026 pages 1-2 enumerate current Saturday/Sunday brunch food, sides, and literal ingredient/allergen statements.
Restaurant-issued HAPPY HOUR MENU March 2026 lists seven current food products for the stated weekday happy-hour period and literal ingredient/allergen statements.
Restaurant-issued VEGAN MENU JULY 2026 lists current daily vegan dishes and literal cashew, peanut, sesame, nut, and gluten statements.
Restaurant-issued KIDS MENU March 2026 lists daily and brunch kids foods, sides, nonalcoholic drinks, and literal cheese, egg, almond, dairy, and gluten statements.
The restaurant-issued daily drink image lists nonalcoholic beer, agua frescas, horchata, coffees, colas, sparkling water, and Calabash teas, including contains-nuts labels for horchata presentations.

An alternate official menu index confirms the service periods for daily, happy-hour, brunch, kids, vegan, and cocktail menus; it exposed no allergen matrix, nutrition guide, or downloadable ingredient guide.

The storefront linked by the restaurant identifies Cielo Rojo 7211 at the current address and exposes the live takeout catalog: food, nonalcoholic beverages, edible masa retail, and family meals. It includes item-level ingredient/contains statements and states that pumpkin seeds in Trio Salsas may be processed in a facility containing nuts, but provides no comprehensive matrix.

Targeted domain and web searches for allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, PDF, and menu surfaced the official image menus, alternate official menu routes, and linked Toast item pages, but no restaurant-issued allergen matrix or comprehensive guide.

attempts.query: Inspect official menu-image/CDN assets, alternate /menus and /menus/daily-menu routes, discoverable image/download surfaces, and official-domain results for allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, PDF, and guide.

matrixSearch.notes: All four required search classes were completed. The matrix status is accurately_unavailable even though current menus contain numerous direct item-level positives. Empty arrays on unavailable items are not absence claims.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Preserved as an exact restaurant-issued menu legend only. It was not converted into item-level wheat/gluten absence claims; products without direct positive disclosure remain unavailable.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Applied conservatively to Trio Salsas & Tostadas as mayContain tree-nut. The statement does not establish restaurant-wide shared-facility exposure.

reconciliation.notes: Every frozen auditItemKey is represented exactly once. Repeated current presentations across official service-period menus, Featured Items, vegan sections, sides, and Toast were consolidated under stable current product keys. Merchandise and Wix/form-parser strings are out of POC food/nonalcoholic scope.

findings.summary: Current restaurant-issued and linked-vendor sources consistently identify the Takoma Park restaurant at 7211 Carroll Avenue; older 7056 Carroll Avenue pages are legacy and were excluded.

The frozen 83-row projection mixes a partial Toast menu with ten clear merchandise/site-parser artifacts, three stale dishes, and broad category misclassification. The complete current union contains 129 consolidated food, nonalcoholic, edible-retail, family-meal, brunch, happy-hour, kids, and vegan products.

No standalone official matrix exists, but the current restaurant-issued image menus and linked Toast descriptions contain many direct item-level ingredient/contains positives. These were preserved without turning menu silence or gluten-free legends into absence claims.

The live linked Toast description states that pumpkin seeds in Trio Salsas may be processed in a facility containing nuts. This product-level statement is preserved as mayContain tree-nut and is not generalized restaurant-wide.

All four required search classes were completed. No restaurant-issued comprehensive allergen matrix, nutrition guide, or full ingredient guide was found, so official matrix status is accurately_unavailable.

proposedChanges: Replace the partial 83-row projection with the 129-product consolidated union of current official daily, brunch, happy-hour, vegan, kids, nonalcoholic, and linked Toast food/nonalcoholic surfaces.
Remove ten out-of-scope merchandise/Wix/form-parser artifacts and three stale dishes; normalize Birria, Chorizo & Papas Taco, and the current vegan chayote-beet salad names.

Retain direct restaurant-issued or linked-vendor allergen positives only, preserve the Trio Salsas product-level nut cross-contact statement as mayContain tree-nut, and mark undisclosed products unavailable.
Treat the official gluten-free menu legend as contextual evidence only; do not convert it into unsupported item-level absence claims.
